audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart said "Skill" at Level 1 and Level 2 while the content layer, the packet chart and both phases' own why-text said Orianna wins those stages.
audit.why: Neeko has no root until level 3 in the common order and must walk into passive-stacked autos to use Blooming Burst (Q, 9s at rank 1); Orianna places the ball at 815 range and never walks up.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side and phases[1].side moved to Orianna, matching win[0]/win[1] and the packet chart; whys rewritten to name the missing root and the 9s Q.

audit.why: Spikes read Lost Chapter, level 6, Luden's and two-plus items, and match Neeko's own spikes: E rank-ups shorten the root from 12s to 10s, and Pop Blossom lands at 6 on a 120s cooldown against your 110s Shockwave.
audit.corrected: Spike cooldown numbers folded into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[2].d so the R-for-R trade is stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all, and the Do's/Don'ts bodies were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles, so the decisive interactions were never stated.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs (E) is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and is her only hard CC before 6; it enlarges and roots longer after passing a champion, so a minion between you shortens it. Pop Blossom (R, 120/105/90s) is a leap with a preparation that is HIDDEN while she is disguised by Inherent Glamour — the clone from Shapesplitter (W, 16s at rank 1) is the tell. Your E shield also grants armour and MR, which is the answer to her Q bloom; Shockwave (110s at rank 1) should be spent on her leap, not on her poke.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries 12s/10s E, 120s R and 9s Q with sequencing; dosFull[0].d states the hidden wind-up, dosFull[1].d states the 12-second punish window, dosFull[2].d states the 120s-vs-110s ult trade, dontsFull[2].d states the E shield's armour/MR answering the bloom.

audit.why: A missed Tangle-Barbs leaves 12 seconds at rank 1 in which Neeko has no lockdown at all.
audit.corrected: Sequencing written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[1].d.

audit.why: Riot's own text confirms the R preparation is hidden while disguised — that is the hidden mechanic this matchup lives on, and it is now on the page.

edits.before: Ball on the wave, autos on her face — your passive-stacked autos win level 1 against almost every mid. Place, don't throw.
edits.after: Ball on the wave and autos on her face: at level 1 her Q is 9s and she has no root yet, so your passive stacks win the contact.

edits.before: Q-W online: the classic chunk combo. Trade it on her last-hits and keep the ball where her approach must cross it.
edits.after: Q-W online and she is still one-spell: chunk her on her last-hits and keep the ball on the line her walk-up must cross.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Command: Protect like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs (E): 12s at rank 1, 10s at rank 5 — her only root and her entire setup. Sidestep it behind minions, then step up inside that window. - Pop Blossom (R): 120s at rank 1 — save Shockwave for her landing. - Blooming Burst (Q): 9s, her only wave clear.

edits.before: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball on your jungler doubles every gank.
edits.after: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball on your jungler brings a shield and a live R in.

edits.before: If Neeko gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Tangle-Barbs (Root) extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with Q-W clears and stay relevant through Shockwave threat.
edits.after: If Neeko gets a kill, respect that a landed Tangle-Barbs is her full combo — hold E for yourself and farm at max Q range. Two kills: never walk past a clone, clear with Q-W, and save R to peel her leap.

edits.before: Neeko wins by landing Tangle-Barbs (Root), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Neeko wins by rooting you at 1000 range and following with Pop Blossom's knockup, so her jungler arrives to a target already stuck.

edits.before: The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Pop Blossom's wind-up is hidden while she is disguised — keep the ball on yourself near clones.

edits.before: Ball on her farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades her combo math can't answer.
edits.after: The moment Tangle-Barbs misses, you have 12 seconds: walk in, Q-W through her, weave two passive-stacked autos, then pull the ball back.

edits.before: Neeko spends Tangle-Barbs (Root) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Her Pop Blossom is 120s at rank 1 — trade your 110s Shockwave for it, never for a Q bloom.

edits.before: That is Neeko’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Root into Q bloom is her whole combo; don't stand still.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when her engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: Your E shield plus its armour and MR eats her Q bloom; a 110-second Shockwave spent on that leaves her R unanswered.
